name: New East New Materials Co., Ltd
summary: Operating within China, New East New Materials Co., Ltd is a key manufacturer and provider of fundamental ingredients for the flexible packaging sector. The firm's comprehensive product range includes specialized inks for pharmaceutical and food flexible packaging, plastic flexible packaging solutions, advanced composite polyurethane adhesives, liquid photosensitive solder resist designed for printed circuit boards (PCBs), and diverse polymer shielding materials. Established in 1983, the enterprise maintains its primary corporate office in Taizhou, China.
